Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The New Zealand players make their way out to the middle. Shamarh Brooks and Brandon King will open the innings for West Indies. New Zealand will begin with spin as Michael Bracewell has been given the ball here.
... RUN CHASE ...

Right then, West Indies have an opportunity here to get a much-needed win under their belt. New Zealand will be looking to take wickets early to build some pressure. We are in for an exciting second half to the game.

Akeal Hosein walks up for a quick word. He says he would have taken this bowling performance at the start of the day but feels he has given 7-8 runs more. Adds that he just tries to be clear and execute his plan. Shares that in the Powerplay they might get hit but he just thinks about the next ball. He continues to say that building partnerships will be the key for the Windies to win.

West Indies started this game completely contrary to their performance in the first two games. They bowled with great control and were really disciplined all innings. They built up the pressure and never let the New Zealand batters get going. Dominic Drakes has justified his selection in the team with an outstanding performance bowling at the start and towards the death. He ended up conceding just 19 runs in his 4 overs and taking a wicket. The spinners bowled well with Akeal Hosein picking up two crucial wickets and Hayden Walsh chipping in with one. Odean Smith was the pick of the bowlers taking three wickets for 29 runs. They will now look to come out and perform with the bat.

New Zealand got off to a really watchful start and were looking to rotate the strike rather than go for boundaries. They seemed to be trying to analyze the wicket but the slow nature of the pitch never allowed them to get any sort of momentum. All the batters got off to starts but never look settled at the wicket. Glenn Phillips was the only one who showed any sort of intent in the game and scored 41 runs of 26 deliveries to keep the scoreboard moving. The strong middle order did not click and could not provide their team with a much-needed impetus towards the end of the innings. In the end, there were unable to cross the 150 mark.

This does not look like a hefty total with 145 on the board and New Zealand will definitely feel they are a few runs short here. However, the pitch seems to be a little slow and we may not be surprised if West Indies have a tough time getting runs too. This is a good opportunity for the Windies to seal a consolation win but New Zealand will know that their opponents have not been in good batting form.
Two runs to end the innings! Short of a length and on middle. Sodhi pulls it to mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs. New Zealand end with 145/7.
FOUR! Crucial runs! A length ball, outside off. Sodhi swings his bat and does enough to clear the mid off fielder.
Ish Sodhi makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! West Indies are doing well to not let New Zealand finish on a high! This is full and on middle. Mitchell swings his bat across but mistimes his shot completely. Dominic Drakes at mid off takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dominic Drakes b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on the pads. Michael Bracewell flicks it to deep square leg. Shimron Hetmyer runs to his left, dives and saves a run for his team.
Angling way outside off, fuller ball. Bracewell fails to drive it away.
Michael Bracewell is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Smith serves a widish full ball, angling way outside off. Neesham throws the kitchen sink at it but only manages to get a faint edge on it. A caught behind appeal but the umpire signals a wide! There was definitely a noise! UltraEdge shows a spike and Neesham goes back without making a big impact this time.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Thomas b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: A slower length ball, around middle, it is pulled to deep square leg for one.
Odean Smith has been asked to bowl the last over.
Wide! This is way down the leg side. Neesham leaves it alone for a wide.
Two runs! On a length and on middle. Neesham works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Wide! First extra off the innings! Bangs a bouncer on middle. Neesham lets it through.
Another inch perfect yorker from Drakes on middle. Mitchell digs it out back to the bowler who fails to stop and it rolls to long on for one.
Short in length and on middle. Neesham pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Nails the yorker, on middle. Mitchell somehow squeezes it away to covers for a single.
A full toss outside off. Mitchell smacks it to long off for a single. The batters see a fumble by the fielder and runs across for the second run.
Dominic Drakes has been brought back into the attack. He has been outstanding today bowling 3 overs for just 9 runs and taking a wicket.
Just five off the over! Excellent from Joseph! This is around off. Mitchell inner edges his drive to short fine leg for a single.
A single as this is hit through point.
Very full and on middle. Mitchell whacks it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off. Mitchell shuffles across and tries to paddle it away but mistimes it to the left of the keeper who does well to get a big hand on it.
On a length and outside off. Neesham chops it to backward point for a single.
Short of a length and on middle, bunted to deep square leg for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! A very good innings from Phillips comes to an end! Smith serves a low full toss, outside off from around the wicket. Phillips pre-meditated as he saw third man up. He tried to reverse paddle it but mistimes and Brandon King at short third man takes it. James Neesham in the new batter that makes his way out to the middle. He has been playing the finishers role to perfection so far and New Zealand will hope he takes them to a reasonable score.
Commentary.Howout: c Brandon King b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! A widish yorker, outside off. Daryl throws his bat and works it through point for a single.
Touch fuller and outside off. Phillips punches it to covers for a single.
An effort ball from Smith! On a length and outside off. Phillips looks to cut it away but misses.
On middle, Daryl Mitchell works it to long on and gets to the other end.
On a length and outside off. Mitchell smacks it to long off for an easy couple.
Odean Smith has been brought into the attack. He has conceded 15 runs in his two overs.
On middle, it is played to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on middle. Mitchell reverse sweeps it but finds point.
Tossed up on middle,it skids through, eased down to long on for a single.
SIX! Powered! Hosein errs in line as he bowls it short and way down the leg side. Phillips uses the depth of the crease as he rocks back and pulls it to square leg for a six.
Tossed up, around middle and leg. Mitchell tucks it to the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
Darted on the pads. Phillips flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off, Glenn Phillips goes for the pull but is not short enough and mistimes his shot towards deep square leg for a single.
Dominic Drakes goes full and wide outside off, Glenn Phillips mistimes his shot towards cover.
Serves this on a good length as well and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell clips the ball to deep square leg for a single.
Dominic Drakes bowls this on a good length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell knocks this towards point.
Daryl Mitchell walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kane Williamson's labored innnings comes to an end! Dominic Drakes bowls a good length delivery angling away from outside off, Kane Williamson charges down the wicket and looks to slash this over the offside field. Does not get the b est of connection and the ball goes straight into the hands of Akeal Hosein at cover. Kane Williamson just did not seem comfortable in this game.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Dominic Drakes

Commentary.Commentary: Dominic Drakes bowls a slow off-cutter, short and outside off, Kane Williamson goes for the pull and misses.
Serves this one short and outside off, Kane Williamson pulls this straight to deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Glenn Phillips works this to deep point for a single.

SIX! What a shot this is! Innovation at its best! Alzarri Joseph goes full and outside off, Glenn Phillips was expecting the ball there. He reverse scoops the ball over the third man fence for a biggie. That shot looks really good!
FOUR! This has been dispatched to add salt to the wound! Alzarri Joseph bowls this short outside off, Glenn Phillips pulls this hard towards the deep square leg fence and gets four runs.

Dropped! Tough chance but that should have been taken! Alzarri Joseph bowls this short and outside off, Kane Williamson goes for the pull and top edges the ball towards fine leg, Akeal Hosein comes running in from the deep and the ball falls in front of him as he dives. He does not hold on to the ball and another dropped catch. They take a single.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this on a good length and outside off, Glenn Phillips strokes this to deep cover for a single.
Bowls a straight line and on a fuller length, Kane Williamson has to defend this towards cover.
Akeal Hosein flights this one full and outside off, Glenn Phillips gets down the wicket and slices his loft shot towards deep cover. The ball falls short of the fielder and they take a single.
Akeal Hosein pulls his length back as he sees Kane Williamson come down the wicket and serves this outside off, Kane Williamson knocks this towards backward point and takes a run.
A fraction short and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips works this towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Flighted full outside off, Kane Williamson knocks this towards cover and takes a single.
Akeal Hosein flights this one full and angling into the pads, Glenn Phillips clips this towards mid-wicket and they take a run.
This is on a good length and outside off, Glenn Phillips knocks this towards point and takes a quick run.
Odean Smith serves a yorker in line with stumps, Kane Williamson digs the ball out to mid on for a run.
Goes full and outside off, Glenn Phillips strokes this to deep cover for a single.

What a beauty in response to that boundary! Odean Smith cowls this back of a length and angling into the batter. The ball straightens after pitching and Glenn Phillips plays inside the line of the ball. Gets beaten all ends up.

FOUR! Another loose delivery from West Indies and gets the treatment! Odean Smith bangs this in short and wide outside off, Glenn Phillips slashes hard at the ball and gets over short third man as the ball rushes to the third man fence for four more runs.
Odean Smith goes a fraction full and just outside off, Kane Williamson clips the ball towards mid-wicket and takes a run.

Hayden Walsh continues bowling short and well outside the off stump, Kane Williamson goes on the back foot and works the ball towards deep cover. There is a misfield and the batters complete three runs.
Short once gain and wide outside off, Glenn Phillips slaps this to deep point for a single.

FOUR! This is a loose delivery from Hayden Walsh! Hayden Walsh bowls a half tracker wide outside off, Glenn Phillips cuts this late towards the deep backward point fence to collect four runs for himself.
Flighted full and outside off, Kane Williamson shimmies down the wicket and clips the ball to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Serves this one a fraction short and wide outside off, Kane Williamson nudges this towards short third man.

FOUR! Kane Williamson starts with a boundary after the break! Hayden Walsh flights this one full and reallyw ide outside off, Kane Williamson strokes this through covers and the ball races away to the deep cover fence for a boundary,

DRINKS! This has been a slow start from New Zealand as they have just not been able to get going. This pitch looks really slow and their timing has been off. West Indies will be happy with the three wickets they have taken. They applied good pressure and did not let New Zealand break the shackles. They will be hoping for the same after the break. New Zealand have a lot of work to do here.

FOUR! Unfortunate for Shepherd! But this is much better over from him than his first one! On a length and outside off, a bit of width and Phillips tries to push. He gets an outside edge to the third man fence.
Another dot! Fourth of the over! Hits the hard length, around off. Phillips works it to covers.
Shepherd continues with the good work! A good length ball, outside off. Phillips looks to push at it but misses.
On middle on a length, nudged to mid-wicket for one more. Better from Shepherd, keeping it tight and not giving anything away.
This one nips back in! Length and around off. Williamson stays back to block it out.
On a length and outside off. Williamson plays it late and straight to point.
Romario Shepherd has been brought back into the attack. He has been expensive so far conceding 13 runs in his first over.
A googly, full and outside off, worked to point.
Touch short and outside off. Williamson cuts it to deep point for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
The impressive Glenn Phillips has made his way out to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Brilliant review from West Indies as they get rid of Conway! Not a wicket-taking delivery but Walsh gets his man! This is tossed up, full and down the leg side. Conway looks to sweep but seems to miss it. An appeal for caught behind but nothing from the umpire. Devon Thomas, the keeper and Walsh look confident. They take it upstairs. UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passes the gloves. The on-field decision needs to be changed. Out it is!
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Thomas b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, tucked to square leg for a single.
Walsh starts with a short ball, outside off. Williamson fails to cut it away.
Hayden Walsh has been given the ball now.
This is full and wide of off. Conway leans and drives but cannot pierce it past the man at cover.
Short of a length and on middle. Williamson bunts it to deep square leg for a single.
On the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a run.
Touch fuller and around off. Williamson drops it in front of point for a single.
FOUR! Finds the fence! This one rises! Shorter and outside off. Williamson gets on his toes and cuts it aerially past point for a boundary.
Fuller ball on off. Williamson works it straight to mid on.
Odean Smith has been brought into the attack.
Tossed up on middle. Williamson plays it gently to mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
Third dot in a row! Shorter, and angling on middle. Williamson keeps it out.
Flatter and on middle. Williamson pushes it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out.
Kane Williamson the skipper of New Zealand makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! This time Santner goes! Akeal Hosein gets his second wicket! Good bowling this from Hosein! Serves it slightly short but quicker and on leg. Santner clears his front leg and tries to clear long but doesn't get much elevation. Rovman Powell there gets low and reverse-cups it.
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Drops it short and quicker on middle. Conway pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Akeal Hosein has been brought into the attack. He has bowled one over for eleven runs but has taken a wicket.
An easy single as Conway dabs this length ball to third man. New Zealand are 47 for 1, at the end of the Powerplay.
On a length and outside off, angling on. Santner looks to drive but gets an inside edge behind square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off, cut hard but straight to point.
On a length and on off. Conway gets inside the line and chops it to point. One.
FOUR MORE! Too easy for Conway! A length ball, way outside off. Conway slaps it through point for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! On a length and on the pads. Conway just stays back and swings across over deep square leg for a biggie.

DROPPED! A chance goes begging for West Indies! Alzarri Joseph bangs this one in short and outside off, Mitchell Santner goes for the pull shot once again and gets a top edge high towards mid-wicket. Odean Smith hovers under the ball but the sun is straight in his eyes. He loses the ball and he just gets some fingers to it. Mitchell Santner is living on the edge here.
Alzarri Joseph serves this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Devon Conway makes room on the leg side and knocks the ball to deep cover for a single.
This is on a good length as well but on the pads, Mitchell Santner clips this towards deep square leg and takes a single.
On a good length and just outside off, Devon Conway gets an inside edge into the pitch and takes a single as the ball rolls towards the keeper. Good awareness from the batters.

Falls right in the gap! Alzarri Joseph bangs this one in short and outside off, Mitchell Santner top edges his pull and the ball lands between mid on and mid-wicket. Mitchell Santner is really lucky and they take a single.
FOUR! What a nice-looking shot! Alzarri Joseph serves this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Mitchell Santner hits this straight over the bowler's head and gets a boundary to long on.
Another mistimed shot for the New Zealand batters. Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Mitchell Santner gets a single to mid off.
This is even shorter and outside off, Devon Conway cuts this hard towards deep point and takes a run.
On a shorter length and outside off, Devon Conway pulls this straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Slightly short once again and angling into the batter, Mitchell Santner looks to pull and inside edges the ball to deep square leg for a single.
Pulls his length back a fraction and serves this outside off, Mitchell Santner fends this back to the right of the bowler.
Dominic Drakes begins with a short delivery wide outside off, Devon Conway reaches for it and hits it uppishly towards deep point for a single.

FOUR! Mitchell Santner is off the mark with a boundary! Akeal Hosein bowls this short and angling into the pads, Mitchell Santner clips this past short fine leg as the ball rushes towards the deep backwards square leg for four runs.
Mitchell Santner is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a comeback from Akeal Hosein! He is brave enough to flight this one full and in line with the stumps. Martin Guptill goes to sweep this across the line but the ball creeps in between bat and pads to shatter the stumps. West Indies have drawn first blood and Martin Guptill has to depart.

SIX! BANG! Martin Guptill is down the wicket to a full delivery outside off. He lifts this high over the long off fence for a biggie. That should release some pressure as New Zealand will look to go after the spinner.
Flights this one full and angling into the batter, Martin Guptill defends this back towards the left of the bowler.
Serves this one full and outside off, Martin Guptill pushes at this and gets an outside edge towards point.
Akeal Hosein starts off with a short ball in line with the stumps, Devon Conway goes back in the crease and pulls the ball towards deep square leg for a single.
Goes full and angling into the pads, Martin Guptill flicks this straight to mid-wicket.
Martin Guptill is looking to attack here. Alzarri Joseph serves this on a good length and angling into the pads, Martin Guptill mistimes his shot just over the mid on fielder for a brace.

FOUR! First boundary for New Zealand! Alzarri Joseph goes full and wide outside off, Martin Guptill has room to free his arms and slices this over point and gets the boundary as the ball runs away to the deep point fence. With that four, Martin Guptill goes past Rohit Sharma as highest run scorer in T20I.
On a good length this time and outside off, Martin Guptill guides this towards backward point.
Goes a fraction full and outside off, Devon Conway plays this wide of mid off and takes a run.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this on a good length but angling down leg, Martin Guptill flicks this to the left of fine leg and takes a single.
Alzarri Joseph to bowl from the other end.
A fraction fuller now and in line with the stumps, Martin Guptill clips this to deep square leg and takes a single. Good over from Dominic Drakes to start the innings. Just 3 runs from it.
Dominic Drakes continues bowling on a good length and outside the off pole. Martin Guptill fends this towards cover.
Good-length delivery once gain outside off, Devon Conway knocks this towards point and takes off for a run. Martin Guptill commits and would have been shot if there was a direct hit.
What a beauty! Dominic Drakes serves this on a good length and outside off, gets the ball to shape away. Devon Conway feels for the ball and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Bowls this on a good length as well and outside off, Martin Guptill taps this with soft hands towards point and takes a quick single to get off the mark.
Dominic Drakes begins with a good-length delivery just outside off, Martin Guptill fends this towards cover-point.

We are all set for the action. The Windies players are out in the middle. Martin Guptill and Devon Conway are the openers for New Zealand. West Indies players take the knee in support of the 'BLM' movement. Dominic Drakes to start with the ball.

Samuel Badree is pitchside. He says that the sky is clear and there is a gentle cool breeze blowing across the stadium. He says it is the same surface as the previous two games. Adds the pitch is quite dry and there are cracks, the spinners will have an impact and so will the slower balls. Says the batters can score runs freely too and he expects a good encounter between bat and ball.

Rovman Powell will captain the West Indies today and he says playing for the West Indies is a dream but captaining the team in front of the home crowd is also a dream come true. Informs there are four changes. Admits it is difficult to lose the previous two games but it gives an opportunity to improve. Shares that the Kiwis batted well but they gave too many freebies in the last game. Hopes the guys can rectify things.

Kane Williamson the captain of New Zealand says they will have a bat. Explains that the condition is good and the surface is the same as the last game hence they chose to bat first. Says that they have a good team but it is about improving and adjusting which enables them to keep playing better cricket. Confirms that they have one change as Lockie Ferguson comes in for Trent Boult.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Brandon King (In place of Kyle Mayers), Shamarh Brooks, Devon Thomas (WK), Shimron Hetmyer, Dominic Drakes (in place of Nicholas Pooran), Rovman Powell (C), Romario Shepherd, Odean Smith, Akeal Hosein (In place of Jason Holder), Alzarri Joseph (In place of Obed McCoy), Hayden Walsh.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Devon Conway (WK), Kane Williamson (C), Glenn Phillips, Daryl Mitchell, James Neesham, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner, Ish Sodhi, Tim Southee, Lockie Ferguson (In place of Trent Boult).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favor of New Zealand. They have elected to BAT first.

New Zealand have been outstanding in white-ball cricket this year. They are unbeaten in the 16 games they have played out of which they have played 9 T20Is. They will be eager to continue this run past the upcoming World Cup. They seem to have a balanced squad at their disposal and will go into the tournament as one of the favorites.
